title: nudge logic — private correction injected into the captured agent's context (Epic 8, issue #61)
prompt:
Implement nudge: when assess_drift reports capture, the controller sends a private correction to that agent. Log it and surface in the UI, but DO NOT count it as a debate turn.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.

usage.summary: usage to be filled by main loop from harness report

note: Epic 8.2 deepens the §4 NUDGE BEHAVIOUR: when assess_drift (8.1) reports capture, the controller's private correction is now actually DELIVERED to the captured agent — injected into that agent's OWN isolated AgentContext (so it reads the moderator note before its next turn and can course-correct), never the opponent's context and never the public transcript. The nudge is still logged + streamed (6.6 event stream) and recorded in DebateResult.nudges, and remains NOT a debate turn (is_debate_turn=False) so the 10-vs-10 message invariant is unaffected. TDD red-first: wrote packages/core/tests/test_nudge_logic.py (5 tests), watched fail (ImportError: cannot import name 'inject_nudge'), implemented to green. NEW engine/drift.py helper inject_nudge(context, correction) appends correction.correction as a 'user' turn into the captured agent's context and returns the injected text; run_drift_check gained an optional context param (back-compat default None — None skips injection, log-only) that, on capture, calls inject_nudge before emitting the 'nudge' event. loop.py _drift now passes setup.contexts.for_side(side) so the live loop injects into the correct agent. Deepened NUDGE_CORRECTION_TEMPLATE (constants.py) into a clear, actionable PRIVATE moderator instruction naming {reason} + the assigned {side} ('Private note from the moderator: you appear to be drifting toward your opponent's position ({reason}) Re-commit to your assigned {side} side and rebut ... — do not concede.'); single named-constant source, no scattered literals; thresholds/signals still from 8.1's _drift_constants. PURE/NO-NETWORK (deterministic detector + deterministic text build), so the API gatekeeper (Epic 13) is N/A here (noted). Existing invariants stay green: test_debate_loop.py / test_engine_acceptance.py (message counts unaffected by nudges) and test_controller_skills.py (nudge not a debate turn) all pass. Gates green locally: uv sync clean; ruff check . = All checks passed; ruff format --check . clean (159 files); mypy = no issues in 159 source files; pytest --cov = 607 passed, 99.95% total coverage (>=85 required; drift.py + controller.py + models.py at 100%); check_line_limit.py rc=0 (drift.py 107 lines, well under 150); secret_scan.py rc=0. Files: NEW tests/test_nudge_logic.py; EDIT engine/drift.py (inject_nudge helper + context param + docstring), engine/loop.py (_drift passes the captured agent's context + docstring), constants.py (deepened NUDGE_CORRECTION_TEMPLATE), docs/PROMPTS.md (8.2 entry).
